flags: WATERFRONT (contrary claim, judged): ND Tourism tags the listing 'Lakefront, Riverfront'. On Esri imagery the RV area is a fan of ~5-6 gravel spurs (centre ~46.24982,-100.21609) inside a meander of Beaver Creek, reached by a vehicle bridge; the creek is ~9-13 m wide (creek-sized) and every spur ends 20-35 m from it behind a continuous band of trees and brush. No open apron, no lake. Not waterfront stands; creekside not earned.

PHONE: stored '' -> 701-680-1864 (ND Tourism's number for the campground; Google shows the same). Linton City Hall is 1-701-254-4267 (city site header). Campendium's 701-254-4985 (earlier verifier) is not on an official page.
